 Produced as part of my master’s thesis on Konungs skuggsjá at University of Bergen. Photographic facsimiles of the whole fragment from the Arnamagnæan Manuscript Collection at the University of Copenhagen. Denmark Copenhagen Den Arnamagnæanske Samling AM 1056 IX 4to A fragment of Konungs skuggsjá 1r–2v Konungs skuggsjá Kgs Norwegian Fragment. See the edition by Ludvig Holm-Olsen (1983), p. 141, for textual correspondence with the main manuscript, AM 243 b alfa fol.

parchment.

 2 leaves; ca 138 mm (height) by 98 mm (width).

1–2

 Two consecutive leaves. However, both of them are defective.

Written in Norway c. 1300.

This encoding follows the standard set out in The Menota handbook (version 2.0), at http://www.menota.org/handbook.xml as of 2008-05-16.

The encoded text has numbered pagebreaks, and linebreaks according to the manuscript.

This text has been transcribed directly from photographic colour facsimiles of the manuscript.

This text has been encoded on all three focal levels: facsimile, diplomatic and normalised.

The whole text has been lemmatised and morphologically analysed.
